line_items.reasoning: Full-year 2024 revenue came in at approximately $81.1B (implied by YTD $61.6B + strong Q4 driven by record Markets, Services, and Wealth performance), meeting or slightly exceeding the $80B–$81B guided range, with Markets posting its highest Q4 revenue in a decade (+36% YoY).

Q4 NII ex-markets was guided to be roughly flat sequentially and full-year 'slightly down'; reported results did not explicitly call out a deviation from this, and no outperformance was flagged, suggesting results landed in line with the revised guidance.

Full-year expenses were guided to the higher end of $53.5B–$53.8B, but 2025 expenses are now guided to only slightly below $53.8B with a $600M repositioning charge still embedded, and the path to a sub-60% efficiency ratio has been pushed beyond 2026, signaling expenses remained elevated and the cost trajectory disappointed.

Branded Cards NCL crept toward ~4% (high end of the 3.5%–4% range) and Retail Services NCL came in at ~6.28%, above the guided high end of the 5.75%–6.25% range, indicating credit losses exceeded the reaffirmed guidance band.

The medium-term RoTCE target was cut to 10%–11% from the reaffirmed 11%–12%, driven by elevated transformation and technology investment needs, representing a clear miss against prior guidance; the revenue CAGR target was not explicitly reaffirmed or raised this quarter.
